text:
Alicia Park: Hey team — Paxwell sent back their vendor security questionnaire and asked for a remediation plan + answers for SOC2 scope and DPA items. They want a combined package by EOD Friday. Form: https://files.paxwell.example/questionnaire.pdf 

Marco Singh: Quick clarifying Q: do they need full control narratives or just evidence pointers for specific gaps?

Alicia Park: They flagged 3 areas: encryption-at-rest KMS provenance, nonprod data access controls, and retention/embeddings retention. They said they need proposed remediation steps where we call out next actions.

Priya Patel: I talked to the customer — they want an itemized plan we can commit to (owners + ETA) and sample evidence where available. They also asked if we support BYOK for this account.

Sam Torres: We don't offer BYOK in-hosted today; we can propose Dedicated or Private for BYOK. For the questionnaire we should: 1) provide current state + gap 2) remediation steps 3) who owns 4) ETA 5) sample evidence path (or redacted snippet).

Alicia Park: Sounds good. Let's split tasks: @Sam — draft answers for questionnaire sections A (org controls), B (data handling), C (crypto). @Marco — collect evidence for KMS, backups, and prod/nonprod segmentation. @Priya — confirm whether Paxwell will accept Dedicated as the BYOK option and coordinate legal for DPA amendments.

Marco Singh: Will pull evidence. Tentative evidence paths: `s3://redwood-evidence/paxwell/soc2/keys/` (KMS attestation doc), `s3://redwood-evidence/paxwell/soc2/backups/` (backup config + snapshot schedule). If we need key provenance beyond our KMS logs we'll need Eng help to export HSM attestation.

Sam Torres: Draft snippet for encryption Q: "Encryption at rest: All tenant data in hosted deployment is encrypted at rest using KMS-managed keys (AES-256). For customers requiring BYOK, we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private with KMS integration; sample config and SLA impacts provided below." I'll add sample evidence: KMS rotation policy doc + key usage logs (redacted).

Priya Patel: Paxwell answered that Dedicated could work but they need pricing + expected migration timeline. I'll request confirmation on acceptance of our proposed Dedicated path.

Alicia Park: Timeline proposal: Tuesday EOD — initial draft answers + evidence pointers. Thursday AM — internal review and legal review. Friday EOD — final package to customer. If anyone can't meet that timeline call it out now.

Marco Singh: Thursday might be tight if we need Eng to extract HSM attestation. If we can't get it by Thu we should send partial package and mark attestation as "in progress" with ETA.

Sam Torres: I can get draft answers done by Tue EOD. I'll include suggested phrasing for remediation steps (example: "Implement scoped IAM roles in nonprod; rotate test keys quarterly; enable prefix-based KV cache anonymization for embeddings retention").

jira-bot: Created ticket RDW-4123: "Paxwell vendor questionnaire remediation plan" assigned to @Alicia Park, priority P2, due 2026-05-15.

Alicia Park: Thanks @Sam and @Marco. I'll assemble the package and run it by Legal. @Priya, once you confirm Dedicated is acceptable we'll include migration notes and pricing.

Priya Patel: I'll ping procurement and get a tentative pricing approval by Wednesday. Also I asked Paxwell to confirm which environments they consider "production" for scope.

Marco Singh: Note for evidence: backups doc contains retention policy (90/365 days) and we should call out restore SLA (2 hrs RPO for critical). I'll attach the relevant PDF to the package.

Sam Torres: One more: include short Q&A for embeddings retention — explain how customers can request data deletion and how long cached embeddings are retained in nonprod vs prod. Put sample retention matrix.

Alicia Park: Great. Action items in-thread: 
- Sam: draft Q1-Q5 answers + sample evidence pointers (due Tue EOD)
- Marco: collect KMS + backup evidence, note any Eng dependencies (due Wed EOD)
- Priya: confirm Dedicated acceptance + legal contact (due Wed EOD)
- Alicia: assemble, legal review, send to Paxwell (target Fri EOD)

Sam Torres: :thumbsup: adding to my list. I'll post a draft in this thread when ready.

Priya Patel: Paxwell also asked about audit windows — I'll ask whether they want raw logs or redacted summaries. If raw logs we need an NDA addendum.

Alicia Park: Good catch. Add to legal questions.

Marco Singh: If anyone needs a specific file path, use the temp share: https://internal.redwood.example/paxwell-evidence . I'll upload what I have by Wed morning.

Alicia Park: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene here when drafts are in.

Sam Torres: Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/paxwell-qna-v1 — feedback welcome.

Priya Patel: Confirmed Paxwell okayed Dedicated in principle; asking for a 2-week migration estimate. Sending note to procurement.

Alicia Park: I'll pull the draft + evidence into a zip and route to Legal for redaction review. Expect a partial send Thursday if Legal needs time.

jira-bot: RDW-4123 status updated to "In Progress".

Marco Singh: Uploaded KMS rotation policy and backup snapshot schedule to internal share.

Alicia Park: Closing loop: partial package went out to Paxwell (marked as interim, attestation pending) — they acknowledged. Final package on track for Friday. :white_check_mark:
